description: Native commands available to the Discord WebView. document_store reads/writes bounded profile-history and moderation-audit documents on the operator's configured HTTPS server only, with revision checks, no redirects, no local disk cache, and credentials held in Rust. Any script on discord.com can call granted commands and could access these operator documents; this is not an isolated security boundary from Discord. Other grants cover notifications, hotkeys, own event reporting/config sync, translation, public HTTPS web requests, and the fixed local Oathnet helper's validated profile/history routes.
